name: Fourteen Words
summary: The Fourteen Words are a white supremacist slogan coined by David Lane, 'We must secure the existence of our people and a future for white children', which first appeared in his 88 Precepts. The sources present it as the core of a worldview in which the white race faces extinction through integration and mixing, to be met by racial separation, racial loyalty above nation and, if need be, force. Lane's precepts add hostility to democracy, usury and materialism, a limited state, and condemnation of homosexuality and abortion.
scope: The slogan and the 88 Precepts, where Georgetown's Bridge Initiative says it first appeared; ADL and SPLC define the slogan and its author. Excluded: Lane's other works, Wotanism, The Order's acts, the other neo-Nazi and white-nationalist groups that use the slogan, and the 1488 symbol beyond what it shows of the slogan.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Precepts 61 and 67 say peace lives only under 'the ready God of War' and unarmed peoples are enslaved.

abortion-legal.rationale: Precept 88 lists infanticide, 'now called abortion', as a sign of a sick nation.

ban-interest.rationale: Precept 76 says usury, interest at any percentage, is 'a high crime which cannot be tolerated'.

basic-income.rationale: Precept 44 says no government can give anything without first taking it and anything more than defense and order is counter-productive.

central-planning.rationale: Precept 44 limits government to defense and internal order, which excludes a centrally planned economy.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Precepts 72 to 75 call materialism base and destructive and say it leads to unnecessary consumption and destruction of the environment.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Precept 20 calls the guilt placed on the White race invalid under history and Natural Law.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Precept 35 calls homosexuality a crime against Nature and Georgetown reports the precepts argue for its criminalization.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Precept 29 calls equality a lie of Nature that destroys 'every superior race, nation or culture', and 20 calls the Aryan people the source of creative genius.

democracy-becomes-oligarchy.rationale: Precepts 46 and 50 say democracy hands power to those who control the media and is always followed by a strongman.

democracy-best.rationale: Precept 45 calls democracy the most dangerous and deadly form of government and precepts 46 to 50 describe it as theft, plunder and a prelude to a strongman.

direct-votes.rationale: Precepts 45 to 49 condemn democracy as rule by those who control the media and as theft by majority, which excludes decisions by direct vote.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Precept 32 calls race-mixing the greatest threat to the Aryan race and Georgetown quotes it as stating the precepts' position.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Precept 26 says violating racial separation leads to conflict or mongrelization and 28 says a multi-racial society violates Natural Law.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Precept 18 says there are no rights in Nature and 73 says true social status comes from service to family, race and nation.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Precept 63 lists control of economic life by others as fatal to a race or culture, so the founding group must hold it.

elite-replacement.rationale: Precept 21 calls forced integration deliberate and malicious genocide, 33 says taxes support the breeding of non-whites, and the ADL ties the slogan to an alleged tide of color managed by Jews.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Precept 18 says there are no rights under Natural Law and 29 rejects equality as a lie; 62 reserves the nation's law for one group.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Precept 62 requires a nation's founding law to name 'the homogeneous racial, cultural group' it exists for, and precept 41 says the folk, the members of the race, are the Nation.

evolved-behavioural-sex-differences.rationale: Precept 34 speaks of women's Nature-ordained instincts and duties.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Precept 34 treats women's roles as Nature-ordained instincts and duties.

generational-constitutional-review.rationale: Precept 45 says the founding law may be amended only by unanimous consent of all parties and otherwise democracy follows.

harm-principle.rationale: Precepts 35 and 88 make homosexuality and drugs crimes or signs of treason regardless of harm to others.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Georgetown reports the precepts argue white superiority, and precepts 20, 22 and 29 speak of superior races and the Aryan people's creative genius as Nature's law.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Precept 18 denies that people have rights at all, only purchases made by themselves, family, tribe or ancestors.

job-guarantee.rationale: Precept 44 limits government to defense and internal order and says it gives nothing without taking.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Precept 41 says racial loyalties supersede national boundaries and the members of the race are the Nation.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Precepts 1, 3 and 6 call religion a fallible human creation and say law must follow Natural Law.

limit-guns.rationale: Precept 67 says an unarmed or non-militant people will be enslaved.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Precept 40 says a race must honor above all earthly things those who have given their lives or freedom for the folk.

media-academia-power.rationale: Precepts 37 and 46 say those who control the media and affairs of the Western world teach what to think and hold power undreamed by kings.

military-force-beyond-defence.rationale: Precept 41 says wars must not be fought for the benefit of another race and 88 lists foreign wars as a sign of a sick nation.

military-force-for-human-rights.rationale: Precept 41 says wars must not be fought for another race's benefit and 33 calls inter-species compassion contrary to Natural Law.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: The ADL describes the Fourteen Words as reflecting the belief that the white race faces extinction from a tide of color controlled and manipulated by Jews, and the SPLC quotes Lane on a Zionist conspiracy to exterminate the White Aryan race.

national-rebirth.rationale: Precepts 16 and 88 describe nations that tolerate the listed signs as sick and dying and precept 50 calls for restoring order under Natural Law.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Precept 37 says a race whose males will not fight to the death to keep their women will perish.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Precept 44 allows 'a limited amount of government' for national defense and internal order and calls anything more counter-productive.

open-borders.rationale: Precepts 21, 28 and 88 treat racial integration and 'aliens in the land' as destroying a nation.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Precept 35 calls homosexuality a crime against Nature, which rules out openly gay service.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: Precept 52 says tyrannies cannot be ended without force and 55 and 68 say political power rests on force and the word without the sword has no authority.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Precepts 25 and 39 say a people without a culture exclusively their own, or ignorant of its past, will perish.

public-ownership.rationale: Precept 44 limits government to defense and internal order and calls anything more counter-productive.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: Precept 21 holds that peoples who allow others not of their race to live among them perish, which calls for keeping other races out by race.

race-social-construct.rationale: Precepts 26, 30 and 32 treat races as natural kinds with instincts ordained by Nature, so racial categories are not constructs.

racial-community-economic-control.rationale: Precept 63 says a race that lets others control its economic life, money, schools, media and offices will perish.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Precepts 14, 37 and 41 make preserving and promoting one's own race the highest loyalty, and 24 says every race needs its own territory.

racial-pride.rationale: Precept 37 calls 'racism', meaning promoting one's own race, 'the proudest word in existence', and precept 19 says a people not convinced of its value will perish.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Georgetown reports the precepts argue for separation between races, and precepts 26 and 27 say a separation must be maintained and 62 writes it into the founding law.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Precept 21 says a people who let others not of their race live among them will perish, and precept 88 lists 'aliens in the land, alien culture' as a sign of a dying nation.

religion-from-peoples-character.rationale: Precept 7 says religion in its best form is the symbology of a people and its culture, and a multi-racial religion destroys a race's uniqueness.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Precept 88 says guardians who show the listed signs commit treason and precept 52 says tyrannies cannot be ended without force.

resist-oppression-despite-death.rationale: Precepts 37 and 40 say a race whose males will not fight to the death perishes and honour above all those who gave their lives or freedom.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Precepts 38 and 88 name persecution of those who warn of the nation's error as a sign of a dying nation and call 'racism' the proudest word.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: Precepts 50 to 52 say tyrannies cannot be ended without force and the precepts name forcing out guardians who commit treason.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Precept 35 calls homosexuality a crime against Nature, which rules out recognising same-sex marriage.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Precepts 34 and 35 ground sex roles and sexuality in Nature's instincts.

simple-living.rationale: Precepts 72 to 75 say the guardians must be untainted by materialism and that unnecessary consumption must not be promoted.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Precept 67 says an unarmed or non-militant people will be enslaved, so private arms are needed.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Precept 44 limits government to defense and internal order, which excludes directing investment.

state-supports-good-ways-of-life.rationale: Precept 88 says guardians who allow immorality such as drugs or homosexuality, or religion not based on Natural Law, commit treason.

strong-leader.rationale: Precept 50 says democracy is always followed by a strongman and that he is the only way to restore order, if chosen well.

total-state.rationale: Precepts 43 and 44 call those who expand government base tyrants and say anything beyond defense and internal order is counter-productive.

traditional-family.rationale: Precept 88 lists destruction of the family unit as a sign of a dying nation and 34 says the life of a race springs from its women's wombs.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Precept 44 says government gives nothing without taking it and that anything beyond defense and internal order is counter-productive.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Precept 77 says a nation with an aristocracy of money, lawyers or merchants will become a tyranny.

notes: Themes searched: all ten. The record is the slogan and the 88 Precepts, which say little on economy beyond usury, materialism and limited government, on foreign policy, technology or ecology. Answers rest on the precept text only (a third-party copy; the SPLC and Georgetown quote it consistently). Lane's autobiography, Wotanism and 'Death of the White Race' are other texts, left out of scope. The 88 Precepts text comes from a third-party copy because no publisher copy was found (see notFound).
